groups.saying_opens: لا يزال هذا الدين قوياً عزيزاً
لا تزال هذه الأمة مستقيماً أمرها

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad, introduced by «ومن حديث» (owner ruling 6): the twelve-caliphs saying from خلف بن هشام, and a second text with the same theme and its own transmitters from النفيلي, which adds the words about Quraysh; both are stored, labelled 1 and 2
«فقلت لأبي» is an embedded scene by Jabir's son, not a link; the father's answer «كلهم من قريش» is part of saying 1
«فلما رجع إلى منزله» is part of saying 2's story; the Prophet is the end of both chains
